thread:
chloe: Quick heads-up — we're targeting the 23:00 UTC change window for the 1.9.0 deployment tonight. Need a 2-paragraph internal blurb and a rollback owner. Can someone grab the blurb please?
samir: I can draft the blurb. Will post a short snippet in ~10m. Who's owning rollback decision? ops-oncall?
ops-oncall: I'm on standby for rollback. Set me as primary, mike as secondary. What's the guardrail for triggering rollback this run?
anya: Suggest rollback if >3% 5xxs sustained for 5m on production or latency p95 doubles vs baseline. Also revert if canary fails NLU regressions in the eval set.
lina: +1 to anya's criteria. Also call out model-version lock — we'll keep the previous tag available for immediate switch.
chloe: Good — include that in the blurb: who to ping, the brief rollback criteria, and the model tag fallback plan. Samir, you good to post now?
samir: Draft below — please copy-edit: "Deploying 1.9.0 at 23:00 UTC. This release updates the routing logic and optimization kernels to reduce token latency for streaming responses. Canary will run in eu-west-1 + us-west-2. If you see sustained >3% 5xx errors for 5 minutes, a p95 latency increase >2x, or failing regressions on the canary eval prompt set, ops-oncall will initiate a rollback to tag v1.8.4. For urgent escalation, page ops-oncall and @mike. Monitoring links: https://grafana.redwood/boards/latency, https://sentry.redwood/teams/infra"
lina: nit: change "reduce token latency for streaming responses" -> "improve streaming token latency on long contexts". Also add a short note about customer-impacted endpoints (chat/generation).
samir: Updated: "...improve streaming token latency on long contexts. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, /v1/stream." Ready to ship as internal blurb?
chloe: Looks good. I'll post this internally once mike confirms rollback rota.
mike: Confirmed. ops-oncall primary, I'll be secondary and available via phone. I've added a short checklist to the deploy runbook: `deploybot start --canary eu-west-1,us-west-2 --verify --timeout 20m`
deploy-bot: deploy request received from chloe for release 1.9.0. Canary targets set: eu-west-1, us-west-2. Expected rollout window: 23:00-23:45 UTC. Will post canary health at +10m after start.
deploy-bot: CANARY: eu-west-1 healthy. 0.1% 5xx, p95 latency 120ms (baseline 110ms). Eval set checks: 96/100 pass.
anya: Nice. Keep an eye on long-tail token stalls — we saw a regression last week on >2048 sequences.
deploy-bot: CANARY: us-west-2 healthy. 0.2% 5xx, p95 latency 135ms (baseline 112ms). Eval checks: 95/100 pass (2 minor rerank diffs logged).
chloe: Minor rerank diffs — can we get sample diffs into the eval dashboard? Link them in the public notes if safe.
lina: I pulled the rerank diffs. They're minor phrasing changes, not safety issues. I'll attach short examples to the internal blurb before publishing.
samir: Final internal blurb ready with examples and the rollback matrix. Posting to #all-hands and #eng-releases in 2 minutes.
ops-oncall: Received. Monitoring panels visible. If thresholds breach, I'll post rollback intent and the `deploybot rollback --to v1.8.4` command.
mike: Small reminder: for dedicated customers with pinned model versions, we need to run a compatibility sweep post-rollout. Added to runbook.
chloe: Thanks everyone — publishing now. I'll also pin this thread for visibility. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: RELEASE: 1.9.0 successfully promoted to prod. Rollback window open for 30 minutes.
lina: Great work. Closing the announce loop and updating the changelog entry.
chloe: If anyone sees anything odd, ping ops-oncall and mention this thread timestamp 1736000000.
